cases.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ckv-k8s-16-explicit
  namespace: demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: selected-checks-reference
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: selected-checks-reference
    spec:
      os:
        name: linux
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
cases.notes: Expected outcomes are annotations, not measurements. Runtime compatibility is not assessed.
